title: “Mediacide”: Francesca Albanese on Israel’s War on Journalism
author: Sharif Abdel Kouddous
content:
UN Special Rapporteur Francesca Albanese's new report argues that the
destruction of truth has become integral to the destruction of the Palestinian
people. The report, "Truth Under the Rubble: Media in the Time of Genocide,"
documents the killing of nearly 300 journalists and media workers in Gaza
since October 2023, Israeli state censorship and incitement, and the role of
Western media and digital platforms in reproducing Israeli narratives.  
  
Drop Site's Sharif Abdel Kouddous spoke with Albanese, an Italian
international lawyer who has served as the UN Special Rapporteur on the
situation of human rights in the Palestinian territories since 2022. They
discuss what she calls "mediacide," Israel's killing of journalists including
Drop Site contributor Hossam Shabat, incitement on Israeli TV, bias in Western
coverage, and the New York Times' response to her report.  
  
Albanese has faced sustained backlash for her work. When she presented the
report to the UN General Assembly on Monday, the Israeli and US
representatives called her a "liar," a "fraud," and a "lunatic," and the chair
asked speakers to focus on the report's contents. The US, Israel, and several
European governments opposed her reappointment last year. Soon afterward,
Secretary of State Marco Rubio imposed economic and travel sanctions on her,
citing her efforts to push the International Criminal Court to investigate US
and Israeli officials and companies. Albanese, who is unpaid in her UN role,
says the sanctions have cut her off from banking, and that her US-citizen
daughter could commit a felony simply by having financial dealings with her.
Her family is now suing the Trump administration.
